description: An accounts receivable or accounts payable aging report: open balances per customer or vendor, split into buckets by how long they have been outstanding.

report_type.description: Whether the report ages amounts owed to the business by customers (accounts_receivable) or amounts the business owes to vendors (accounts_payable).

report_title.description: The title of the aging report as printed, e.g. 'Accounts Receivable Aging Report'.

company_name.description: Name of the business whose receivables or payables are being aged, as printed in the report header.

as_of_date.description: The date the balances are aged as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

aging_buckets.description: The aging bucket column headings in the order they appear, from current to oldest, e.g. 'Current', '1-30 Days Past Due', 'Over 60 Days Past Due'.

items.description: One aging bucket column heading as printed.

accounts.description: One entry per customer or vendor row in the report, in document order. Exclude the total row.

name.description: Customer name (receivables) or vendor name (payables) for this row.

classification.description: Any classification code printed for the account, such as an MWBE status (e.g. 'W' for women-owned, 'M' for minority-owned). Null if the cell is blank or a dash.

program_funds_used.description: Amount of program or lender funds used for this account, if the report has such a column (e.g. 'ESD Funds Used'). Null if blank.

total_balance.description: Total open balance for the account across all aging buckets.

current.description: Amount not yet due (the 'Current' bucket). Null if the cell shows a dash or is blank.

days_1_30.description: Amount 1 to 30 days past due. Null if the cell shows a dash or is blank.

days_31_60.description: Amount 31 to 60 days past due. Null if the cell shows a dash or is blank.

days_61_90.description: Amount 61 to 90 days past due, only if the report has a separate 61-90 bucket. Null otherwise.

over_oldest_bucket.description: Amount in the oldest, open-ended bucket, such as 'Over 60 Days Past Due' or 'Over 90 Days'. Null if the cell shows a dash or is blank.

classified_account_count.description: Count printed in the total row of the classification column (e.g. number of MWBE accounts), if any.

program_funds_used.description: Total program or lender funds used, if printed.

total_balance.description: Grand total of all open balances.

days_61_90.description: Total 61 to 90 days past due, only if the report has that bucket.

over_oldest_bucket.description: Total of the oldest, open-ended bucket.
